"1. Work done by conservative forces: 
     • Example: Gravitational force, spring force. 
     • Property: Path independent, depends only on initial and final positions. 
     • Can be positive, negative, or zero. 
2. Work done by non-conservative forces: 
     • Example: Applied force, air resistance. 
     • Property: Path dependent, depends on the trajectory. 
     • Includes dissipative forces like friction. 
3. Work done by friction force: 
     • Example: Friction force opposes motion, 
     • Property: Always path dependent and can be positive or negative depending on the direction of motion. 
4. Work done by all forces: 
     • Net work done by all forces results in a change in kinetic energy as per the Work-Energy Theorem."
